sph_interpretive_translation: Upon deliberation with qualified Brahmanas, the fault of the speaker shall be ascertained.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from alignment with realized Brahmanas
Causation is determined through collective scriptural intelligence
Restoration logic operates through purification of speech
Consciousness alignment occurs when error is identified by qualified seers
executable_legal_axioms: IF a verbal act causes disruption THEN qualified Brahmana assembly MUST evaluate speaker's intent AND context
IF speaker's capacity is impaired THEN restoration protocol initiates automatically
IF fault is confirmed THEN corrective speech protocols MUST be executed before further discourse
IF no Brahmana assembly is present THEN delay adjudication until competent authority manifests
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority rests in realized Brahmana councils; individual judges must consult qualified seers before finalizing rulings involving speech-related dharmic violations
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Fault determination follows pramāṇa-based investigation; sequential manifestation of error is traced through causal layers; proportional response aligns with speaker's capacity; punitive measures are excluded as they disrupt cosmic balance
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Speaker undergoes Vak Yoga purification process
Qualified Brahmana council conducts antaḥkaraṇa śuddhi ritual
Community listening practices are reinstated with enhanced awareness
Speaker completes Mantra Śuddhi initiation to restore truthful expression capacity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam: This law flows from the eternal Dharma; restoration prevails over punishment; consciousness alone is the ultimate judge; speech purified, dharma established.
